title: Figure 3. Internal Structure of a Seemingly One-Dimensional Object (Kaluza-Klein)
description: Line drawing of a thin line that, within a magnified circular inset, is revealed to be a tube with circular cross-sections, illustrating a compactified extra dimension. Caption reads "Figure 3. Internal Structure of a Seemingly One-Dimensional Object". Surrounding text discusses Kaluza-Klein theory, Oskar Klein's compactified 5th dimension and the garden-hose analogy, with equation (5.1) at top.
